official_google_search_sources.finding: No special AI markup or extra technical requirement is needed beyond eligibility for indexed Google Search results with a snippet and normal SEO fundamentals.
Clear purpose, useful content, visible expertise and verifiable authorship support people-first quality.
Structured data must represent visible page content accurately and does not guarantee a rich result.
Redirects, self-referential canonicals and canonical sitemap URLs reinforce the preferred URL.

JSON-LD graph for WebSite, WebPage, Book, accurate author Persons, Delirium Support Press and the cover ImageObject
Alasdair MacLullich entity links to ORCID, University profile, Research Explorer and personal site
Sharmella Summan represented only by facts visible on the page
Canonical-root internal links from policy pages instead of index.html duplicates
Semantic author headings and corrected intrinsic image dimensions
Footer policy navigation remains visible on small screens
Sitemap reduced to canonical URLs and truthful last-modified dates
